description: Runs every on-page SEO, GEO and AXO check on one URL: title and meta, headings, canonical, robots directives, hreflang, structured data, links, speed, and whether AI crawlers can read the page without JavaScript. Use it to check a page or to confirm a fix. With the Chrome extension connected it also compares the raw HTML with the rendered page and measures LCP and CLS; without it, those checks come back not_applicable and a note says so. Returns url (the final URL after redirects), status (its HTTP status), findings, and notes on what could not be checked. Each finding has checkId (a WorkPods check id), layer (seo, geo, axo), group, status (pass, partial, fail or not_applicable), severity (critical, high, medium or low on a fail or partial, null otherwise), a one-sentence summary and evidence (selector, url, value, note).

brandName.description: The site's brand name as people search for it, such as "Acme Running". When given, the organization identity check compares the home page schema with it.

url.description: The page to check, an absolute http or https URL such as https://example.com/.

name: audit_page
title: Check a page
